projects.title: Lecionario
bullets: Built a large TypeScript web application across roughly 500 files, adding an automated test suite and CI to catch regressions early.
Packaged the application with Docker so teammates could run an identical environment instead of debugging local setup differences.

projects.title: Scriptorium Divinum
bullets: Modeled relational data in PLpgSQL for a content-heavy TypeScript application, then wrote automated tests around the trickiest queries.
Introduced stricter ESLint rules after a subtle bug slipped past review, cutting down on repeated review comments.

projects.title: A Bancada Evangelica
bullets: Built a NestJS backend and React frontend to evaluate public figures against defined criteria using official public data sources.
Wrote end-to-end tests with Playwright after early manual QA missed a data-parsing edge case, catching similar issues automatically since.

leadership.title: Testing Practices Lead
bullets: Started a weekly session where classmates traded flaky-test fixes, after noticing several projects shipped without any automated tests.
Learned that a small, consistent testing habit prevented more bugs than any single clever fix.
